_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Quality Engineering Inspection Requirements and Equipment List
summary: The Quality Engineering Inspection Requirements and Equipment List identifies required QAP/SQAP and Special Inspection Equipment for hardware build and rebuild, and cross-indexes quality engineering documentation to design engineering documentation.
use_relationship:
a. The Quality Engineering Acceptance Inspection Requirements and Equipment List identifies areas where documentation is available, and where it must yet be prepared.
b. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement delineated in the contract.
c. Quality Engineering Inspection Requirements and Equipment List is applicable to contracts that specify the requirement for Government monitoring of the contractor's technical documentation effort.
d. It also identifies required or existing Quality Assurance Provisions (QAP), or existing supplementary Quality Assurance Provisions (SQAP) as well as the Special Inspection Equipment (SIE) needed for build and rebuild of hardware.
e. This list provides the status of quality engineering documentation to plan work, and to cross index the quality engineering documentation to the design engineering documentation.
f. This DID may be used when the provisions of ISO9001 apply to the contract. This document may be obtained from www.iso.org

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Quality Engineering Inspection Requirements and Equipment List shall be in the following format and contain the data as shown. Data shall be indexed by generation breakdown and hardware drawing number sequence. Data shall include a cross-reference index for acceptance of rebuild in the contractor's plant or depot (when required).

children.title: Level
children.content: The generation breakdown of the part or assembly (Major End Items "1")

children.title: End Item Code
children.content: The End Item Code of the part or assembly.

children.title: QAP (see Table 1)
children.content: The source of inspection engineering requirements and preproduction (environmental) criteria.

children.title: Spec No.
children.content: A number in parenthesis indicates it is scheduled but has not been released.

children.title: QAP
children.content: "QAP" Requirement indicates the need for a QAP and the QAP number in parenthesis indicates an unvalidated QAP.

children.title: Rev.
children.content: QAP revision level released. (# indicates new release).

children.title: SIE or Commercial
children.content: SIE Test Equipment Number used in the performance of a QAP or around which a QAP should be written. Identify rebuild or depot test equipment when different from build test equipment.

children.title: P/PCI
children.content: Preproduction/Production comparison inspection is contained in QAP.

children.title: LET
children.content: Limited Environmental Test contained in QAP.

children.title: SQE
children.content: Storage Quality Evaluation contained in QAP.

children.title: Supply Source
children.content: The present source of supply is indicated in this column as follows: C - Company S - Subcontractor of company V - Vendor/supplier of company G - Government Furnished Equipment (GFE) O - Other.

children.title: Spare*
children.content: "Y" - Yes, can be provisioned as a Spare as it has adequate QAP, engineering requirements and provision for test Equipment. "N" - No, does not have adequate QAP, or Engineering Requirements to be Provisioned as a spare Special Inspection Equipment is not feasible due to cost or other reason.

children.title: Notes (See Table 2)
children.content: Notes referenced by Code Letter in this column are Listed in Table 2.

children.title: Change Identification
children.content: "A" - Item added since last revision. "C" - Indicates a change since the last revision.

children.title: Item (n) is not to be used as spares provisioning list.
children.content: When approved by the Government Product Assurance element, this coding input to the spares provisioning conferences.
